Die nächsten beiden Einstellungen gelten: The next two settings only apply to the local AI (Ollama) — with a cloud provider or “No AI” nothing is loaded.
Whisper turbo — erkennt jede Sprache gle: Whisper turbo — recognizes every language equally well.

KI bleibt dauerhaft geladen (rund 3,3 GB: The AI stays loaded permanently (about 3.3 GB of memory) — fastest response, but it takes up memory while gaming.
Kein Warmhalten — maximal freier Speiche: No keeping warm — maximum free memory, first dictation slower.
Gibt RAM schnell frei. Erstes Diktat nac: Frees RAM quickly. The first dictation after a pause is a few seconds slower (partly hidden by parallel loading).
Guter Mittelweg: kurze Arbeitspausen ble: A good middle ground: short work breaks stay fast, after that RAM is freed.
Modelle bleiben lange warm — RAM länger: Models stay warm for a long time — RAM is occupied longer.
Maximal reaktionsschnell, RAM am längste: Maximum responsiveness, RAM occupied the longest.
Startet Fleech automatisch beim Windows-: Starts Fleech automatically when you sign in to Windows.
Name in der Begrüßung auf Home — und die: Name in the greeting on Home — and the signature under dictations in the “Email” profile. Empty means: the email ends with the closing phrase, without a name (a guessed name under an email would be worse).

Nur beim Anstupsen: So lange still = Dik: Nudge only: this much silence = dictation done. Shorter cuts off thinking pauses, longer makes you wait.
„Aufnehmen“ klicken, dann Taste, Kombina: Click “Record”, then press a key, a combination or mouse button 4/5/middle. Esc, Del or Backspace = clear the binding.
Takes effect from the next recording.

Only right afterwards, and only as long as you haven’t switched windows. Fleech can’t tell whether you typed something yourself — in that case, delete by hand instead.
Kurz drücken = nächstes Profil. GEDRÜCKT: Short press = next profile. HOLD = list of all profiles at the mouse pointer, click one there. Useful on an extra mouse button (mouse4/mouse5) — which is why it has no default. Esc in the recording field clears a binding.

Geräte, die nie als Mikrofon gelten soll: Devices that should never count as a microphone — one part of a name per line. Fleech already recognizes the common loopback devices by itself; this list is for the cases that slip through.
Taste halten = aufnehmen, loslassen = fe: Hold the key = record, release = done.
Einmal drücken = Start. Hörst du auf zu: Press once = start. When you stop talking, the dictation is done — without touching the key again. A second press still ends it immediately.
Spoken trigger word for commands, e.g. “Kimono, make it more formal”.
„Slash Hunter“ wird zu „/Hunter“. Ersetz: “Slash Hunter” becomes “/Hunter”. Four words are replaced (slash, backslash, hashtag, “Klammeraffe”) as soon as another word follows: attached to a name (“/Hunter”), before ordinary text with a space (“# or”). “Raute”, “Unterstrich”, “Schrägstrich”, “Minus” and “Plus” stay text — they are ordinary German words.
Fügt den Text dort ein, wo das Diktat be: Inserts the text where the dictation began — even if you clicked somewhere else in between.
Automatisch — erkennt Formeln im Fließte: Automatic — recognizes formulas in running text

A distinct sound for critical banners.

Play a test banner and a test sound.
„Wichtiges“ meldet nur Probleme (Fehler,: “Important” only reports problems (errors, provider quota); “Everything” also reports status messages like “running in the background”.

Ambiguous expressions are translated by the usual precedence rules and marked as “guessed” in the preview; say “open parenthesis … close parenthesis” if it needs to be unambiguous.
Keine Formel-Erkennung. Alles wird als n: No formula recognition. Everything is treated as normal text.
Verlauf, gelerntes Vokabular und Einstel: History, learned vocabulary and settings are stored encrypted (AES-256); the key is {ort}.

Noch nicht notiert. Ohne Code sind die D: Not written down yet. Without the code, your data is gone after a reinstall.

Der Code öffnet deine Daten, falls das W: The code opens your data if the Windows account is lost (reinstall, new computer). Without it, the data can no longer be read.
Keine Verbindung — Internet oder Adresse: No connection — check your internet or the address.
Dein diktierter Text — nicht die Tonaufn: Your dictated text — not the audio recording — is sent to {ziel} for cleanup and processed there under its terms. The provider bills the costs through your key (usually fractions of a cent per dictation).
Kontingent erschöpft oder zu viele Anfra: Quota used up or too many requests.

Nur wenn die lokale KI nicht rechtzeitig: Only if the local AI doesn’t answer in time or fails does the text of that one dictation — not the audio recording — go to {name}. History then says “cleaned up in the cloud”.
Laufen viele Programme nebenher, kann di: When many programs run alongside, the local AI can become very slow. Fleech only waits for a limited time (about 6–20 s depending on the length of the dictation) and then uses the raw text — or, if chosen here, a cloud provider.
Antwortet die lokale KI nicht rechtzeiti: If the local AI doesn’t answer in time, Fleech inserts the recognized text without cleanup. During processing, the checkmark in the pill does the same immediately.
Wird im Schlüsselbund des Systems abgele: Stored in the system’s credential store, never in a file. The same key also applies if you choose this provider as your main AI above.
Who cleans up your text and how much. A cloud provider needs its own API key — a subscription like ChatGPT Plus or Claude Pro doesn’t count.
Nach dieser Zeit blendet sich die Pille: After this time the pill hides.
Mausklicks gehen durch die Pille hindurc: Mouse clicks go through the pill — including the pill’s own buttons: ✕, ✓, pause and dragging no longer work then. Way back: “Edit pill” further up.

Grobe Echtzeit-Vorschau beim Sprechen (z: Rough real-time preview while you speak (extra model, ~0.5 GB VRAM).
